text: Always act according to your conscience—especially if it is disadvantageous to you. Your true Self is inseparably connected with your conscience. And you always feel which choice, which action is done according to conscience and which is not. Following this knowledge may be inconvenient for your ego, but every such step strengthens your inner core and brings you closer to God. If such actions lead to a result that is disadvantageous for you, regard what is happening as spiritual purification.
